narr: High pressure centered near the Four Corners brought moisture over Arizona which developed into strong thunderstorms.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain and flooding from Dewey and the Agua Fria River to Humbug Creek and Mayer. Water was flowing over roads in Dewey and Meyer. A river gauge in Meyer showed a two foot rise.
lsr: WATER COMING OVER ROADS IN DEWEY.
RISE OF 2 FEET FROM YAVAPAI COUNTY STREAM GAGE.
PUBLIC REPORTS WATER OVER THE ROAD NEAR CENTRAL AVENUE IN MAYER. FLOW FROM BIG BUG CREEK.
